questions.question: In this question, a statement given is followed by two assumptions numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true and decide which of the assumptions is valid in the statement.Statement:‘I want to sell my household items, so I will send the pictures of all the items to your email ID.’ – Sonali told Bendre.Assumptions:I. Bendre can offer good price for the household items of Sonali.II. Bendre is facilitating the sale of Sonali’s household items.
options: Both assumptions I and II are valid.
Neither assumption I nor II is valid.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Neither assumption I nor II is valid.) है।

questions.question: Given below is a statement followed by two possible reasons numbered I and II. Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two reasons explain(s) the event/observation/information given in the statement.Statement: Despite a significant increase in online advertising spending by retail companies, the footfall in physical stores has continued to decline in major cities of State V.Reasons: (I) More consumers in State V are preferring the convenience of online shopping and home delivery.(II) Rental costs in cities of State V for retail spaces have risen significantly, resulting in fewer new store openings.
options: Only I is a possible reason.
Neither I nor II is a possible reason.
Only II is a possible reason.
Both I and II are possible reasons.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Only I is a possible reason.) है।
